card: Updates the minisketch subtree to incorporate upstream PR #105, declaring ID_TRANS as inline constexpr in C++17 or newer. This avoids unused constant variable warnings in translation units that include the header without using ID_TRANS. The update unblocks PR #36275, which enables the -Wunused-const-variable compiler warning flag across the project.
evidence: PR description notes this change is "Used in #36275", which enables -Wunused-const-variable across the build.
problem: In C++17, header-defined non-inline constexpr objects have internal linkage, triggering -Wunused-const-variable compiler warnings in translation units that include the header without referencing ID_TRANS.
summary: Updates the src/minisketch subtree to commit a12f5de1c9, incorporating upstream minisketch PR #105. The change declares the ID_TRANS singleton as inline constexpr when compiling under C++17 or later.
